  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]

  WHY: The PR description and rollout notes describe that configuration and fallback, but the sweep instead creates queue issues directly through the GitHub API.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:Procedure steps 0-4 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `/fix-claude-pr` does not re-check `CLAUDE_FIXER_ENABLED` for the target repository before claiming the head and pushing a fix.
  WHY: A fixer session can still claim and modify a `claude/*` PR when the operator has disabled Claude-fixer mode.

  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml` `claude-pr-catch-all` job env block and `scripts/claude_pr_sweep.py`.
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The job env block does not pass `CLAUDE_ISSUE_ROUTINE_TOKEN` or `CLAUDE_ISSUE_ROUTINE_ID`; `scripts/claude_pr_sweep.py` makes no API call involving these vars and does not implement the documented fallback path.
